mapper.select: SELECT p.payment_id, p.member_id, p.merchant_id, p.koces_cd, p.message_number, p.institution_code, p.transmission_date, p.trace_number, p.merchant_number, p.card_number, p.track_data, p.key_in, p.input_method, p.amount, p.transaction_type, p.approval_number, p.response_code, p.cancel_code, p.original_trade_date, p.original_approval_number, p.original_amount, p.remaining_point, p.filter_value, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, COALESCE(mer.merchant_name, p.merchant_name) AS merchant_name, mer.business_number AS business_number, COALESCE(mer.representative, p.representative) AS representative, COALESCE(mer.contact, p.phone) AS phone, COALESCE(mer.address, p.address) AS address, COALESCE(mer.terminal_id, p.terminal_id) AS terminal_id, mem.name AS member_name, mem.birth_date AS birth_date, mem.organization AS organization, mem.gender AS gender FROM payment p LEFT JOIN merchant mer ON p.merchant_id = mer.merchant_id LEFT JOIN member mem ON p.member_id = mem.member_id WHERE p.payment_id = #{paymentId} AND p.transmission_date = #{transmissionDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment ( member_id, merchant_id, koces_cd, message_number, institution_code, transmission_date, trace_number, terminal_id, business_number, merchant_name, representative, phone, address, card_number, track_data, key_in, input_method, amount, transaction_type, approval_number, response_code, cancel_code, original_trade_date, original_approval_number, original_amount, remaining_point, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{merchantId}, #{kocesCd}, #{messageNumber}, #{institutionCode}, #{transmissionDate}, #{traceNumber}, #{terminalId}, #{businessNumber}, #{merchantName}, #{representative}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{cardNumber}, #{trackData}, #{keyIn}, #{inputMethod}, #{amount}, #{transactionType}, #{approvalNumber}, #{responseCode}, #{cancelCode}, #{originalTradeDate}, #{originalApprovalNumber}, #{originalAmount}, #{remainingPoint}, 'CANCELED', NOW() )

INSERT INTO payment ( member_id, merchant_id, institution_code, message_number, transmission_date, card_number, input_method, amount, transaction_type, approval_number, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{merchantId}, #{institutionCode}, #{messageNumber}, #{transmissionDate}, #{cardNumber}, #{inputMethod}, #{amount}, #{transactionType}, #{approvalNumber}, #{status}, NOW() )
